title: Technology Sector Update for 02/06/2019: VIAV,SWKS,SNAP,ARLO

Technology stocks were trading higher this afternoon, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding nearly 0.3% in value although the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was racing to a more than 2.6% gain.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Viavi Solutions ( VIAV ) rose almost 9% after late Tuesday reporting non-GAAP fiscal Q2 net income of $0.22 per share, up from $0.10 per share a year ago and beating the Capital IQ consensus expecting a $0.16 per share normalized profit for the three months ended Dec 29. Net revenue increased to $306.9 million from $205.4 million last year, also exceeding the $280.9 million analyst mean.
In other sector news:
(+) Snap ( SNAP ) jumped 22% on Wednesday after narrowing its non-GAAP Q4 net loss to $0.04 per share compared with a $0.13 per share adjusted loss during the year-ago period and beating the Capital IQ consensus expecting an $0.08 per share non-GAAP loss.
(+) Skyworks Solutions Inc. ( SWKS ) advanced Wednesday, rising more than 11%, after the specialty chipmaker's board authorized a new stock buyback program of up to $2 billion over the next two years.
(-) Arlo Technologies ( ARLO ) slumped 50% after the mobile monitor equipment company projected a larger non-GAAP net loss for the current quarter ending in March than Wall Street is expecting. It sees an adjusted Q1 net loss in a range of $0.51 to $0.55 per share while a single analyst estimate is calling for a $0.35 per share non-GAAP loss.
